name: Wasped!
source:
Set in South America, you will meet Mateo, who has to deal with his own complexes and commitments before being able to declare his feelings to Wally, with whom he will be joining the company Melo S.A. While competing with his new friend Mario, to find out who will stay with him in the end.

[From [url=https://kanonbold.itch.io/wasped]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以南美为背景，你会遇到马特奥，他必须先处理好自己的情结和承诺，然后才能向沃利表达自己的感情，他将与沃利一起加入Melo S.A. 公司，同时与他的新朋友马里奥竞争，看看谁最终会和他在一起。

[来自[url=https://kanonbold.itch.io/wasped]Itch.io[/url]]
